samuel1.3.p1.b1.text: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare and visions were scarce.

samuel1.3.p1.b2.text: And at that time Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see, was lying in his room.

samuel1.3.p1.b3.text: Before the lamp of God had gone out, Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was located.

samuel1.3.p2.b1.text: Then the LORD called to Samuel …

samuel1.3.p2.b3.text: “Here I am, for you have called me.”

samuel1.3.p2.b4.text: “I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.”

samuel1.3.p3.b2.text: “My son, I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.”

samuel1.3.p3.b3.text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

samuel1.3.p4.b1.text: Once again, for the third time, the LORD called to Samuel.

samuel1.3.p4.b2.text: “Here I am, for you have called me.”

samuel1.3.p4.b3.text: Then Eli realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy.

samuel1.3.p4.b4.text: “Go and lie down,” he said to Samuel, “and if He calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’”

samuel1.3.p5.b1.text: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before,

samuel1.3.p6.b1.text: … I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle.

samuel1.3.p6.b2.text: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his family, from beginning to end.

samuel1.3.p6.b3.text: … because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.

samuel1.3.p6.b4.text: Samuel lay down until the morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,

samuel1.3.p7.b2.text: “What was the message He gave you?” … “Do not hide it from me. …”

samuel1.3.p7.b3.text: “He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”

samuel1.3.p7.b4.text: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.
